facts.fact: Alwasat, reporting an analyst study, says Libya's National Committee for Digital Transformation is the body responsible for drafting the national digital transformation strategy.

LBY.note: Study notes no unified body regulating data flow but states no law or draft on data sharing.

facts.fact: Alwasat reports an analyst study saying government data is spread across several bodies without unified standards and recommending a national interoperability framework with binding standards.
